major_0_fool.title: 0. The Fool
major_0_fool.summary: The Fool is assigned to Uranus, the planet of rebellion and revolution.
major_0_fool.fullText: The Fool, who doesn’t care what society thinks, naturally aligns with Uranus, the planet of rebellion, revolution, and unpredictable change. It represents an innocent wanderer stepping into a new reality.

major_1_magician.title: I. The Magician
major_1_magician.summary: The Magician corresponds to Mercury, the planet of speed, intellect, and communication.
major_1_magician.fullText: As the master of banter and fast talk, The Magician is assigned to Mercury, the planet of speed and communication. He is often depicted pointing heavenward, conveying messages from the heavens above to the Earth below.

major_2_high_priestess.title: II. The High Priestess
major_2_high_priestess.summary: The High Priestess is governed by the Moon, representing the mystical, intuitive, and subconscious realms.
major_2_high_priestess.fullText: The High Priestess is inextricably linked to the Moon, acting as a channel for mystical, intuitive, and deeply subconscious energies. She embodies the divine feminine and the hidden mysteries of the psyche.

major_3_empress.title: III. The Empress
major_3_empress.summary: The Empress corresponds to Venus, the goddess of love, beauty, and creative attraction.
major_3_empress.fullText: The Empress is the pure embodiment of constructive, creative energy. Assigned to Venus, she represents love, attraction, fertility, and the flourishing beauty of the natural world.

major_4_emperor.title: IV. The Emperor
major_4_emperor.summary: The Emperor is assigned to Aries, the initiator of the zodiac ruled by Mars.
major_4_emperor.fullText: Representing the ultimate authority figure, The Emperor corresponds to Aries, the ram. He acts as the initiator, bringing order, structure, and dynamic leadership, fueled by the assertive drive of his ruling planet, Mars.

major_5_hierophant.title: V. The Hierophant
major_5_hierophant.summary: The Hierophant is assigned to Taurus, seeking to maintain spiritual and material traditions.
major_5_hierophant.fullText: The Hierophant acts as the maintainer, corresponding to Taurus, the bull. Governed by Venus, he wants to preserve his traditions, the status quo, and the spiritual or material treasures he has accumulated over time.

major_6_lovers.title: VI. The Lovers
major_6_lovers.summary: The Lovers correspond to Gemini, the sign of thought, communication, and twin souls.
major_6_lovers.fullText: The Lovers are twin souls who think and speak as one, finding their natural home in Gemini. As the questioners ruled by Mercury, they represent the duality of choices, partnership, and intellectual harmony.

major_7_chariot.title: VII. The Chariot
major_7_chariot.summary: The Chariot is assigned to Cancer, the sign of motherhood, home, and family protection.
major_7_chariot.fullText: Just as the crab carries its home on its back, The Charioteer is safely ensconced in his protective shell. Ruled by the Moon, this card represents the emotional nurturer who balances opposing forces to move forward safely.

major_8_strength.title: VIII. Strength
major_8_strength.summary: Strength corresponds to Leo, representing courage, the heart, and gentle force.
major_8_strength.fullText: Strength is the master of gentle force and emotional control, assigned to Leo, the sign of lionesque courage and heart. Ruled by the Sun, it reflects the loyalist who seeks creative expression and play.

major_9_hermit.title: IX. The Hermit
major_9_hermit.summary: The Hermit is assigned to Virgo, representing quiet leadership, duty, and dedicated service.
major_9_hermit.fullText: The Hermit acts as the quiet leader and the modifier. Ruled by Mercury, this card corresponds perfectly to Virgo, the sign dedicated to responsibility, careful analysis, and selfless service to others.

major_10_wheel_of_fortune.title: X. The Wheel of Fortune
major_10_wheel_of_fortune.summary: The Wheel of Fortune corresponds to Jupiter, the planet of luck, expansion, and cycles of growth.
major_10_wheel_of_fortune.fullText: Assigned to the expansive planet Jupiter, The Wheel of Fortune represents the ever-turning cycles of fate, luck, and destiny. It reflects philosophical growth and the opportunities brought by shifting cosmic tides.

major_11_justice.title: XI. Justice
major_11_justice.summary: Justice is assigned to Libra, the sign of the balanced scales and the fair judge.
major_11_justice.fullText: Representing the ultimate judge, Justice corresponds to Libra, the sign of the balanced scales. Ruled by Venus, this card emphasizes equality, legal matters, harmonious partnerships, and weighing actions carefully.

major_12_hanged_man.title: XII. The Hanged Man
major_12_hanged_man.summary: The Hanged Man corresponds to Neptune, representing spiritual sacrifice and mystical surrender.
major_12_hanged_man.fullText: As one of the spiritual 'Mother' cards of the Tarot, The Hanged Man is linked to the outer planet Neptune. It signifies a willing suspension of the ego, profound sacrifice, and tapping into the boundless spiritual realm.

major_13_death.title: XIII. Death
major_13_death.summary: Death corresponds to Scorpio, the catalyst demanding transfiguration, endings, and change.
major_13_death.fullText: Death acts as the ultimate catalyst for rebirth, assigned to Scorpio and ruled by Pluto. The angel of Death demands transfiguration, stripping away the old to make room for profound, unavoidable psychological change.

major_14_temperance.title: XIV. Temperance
major_14_temperance.summary: Temperance is assigned to Sagittarius, the adventurous alchemist seeking higher philosophy.
major_14_temperance.fullText: Temperance, often depicted as The Alchemist, corresponds to Sagittarius. Ruled by Jupiter, it reflects the adventurer's honest, optimistic spirit, blending elements together perfectly in the pursuit of travel, philosophy, and higher truth.

major_15_devil.title: XV. The Devil
major_15_devil.summary: The Devil corresponds to Capricorn, facing the material world in exchange for physical rewards.
major_15_devil.fullText: The Devil, or the Dark Lord, is the ultimate pragmatist assigned to Capricorn. Ruled by Saturn, this card represents facing the cold, cruel material world and grappling with the restrictions and worldly ambitions of physical existence.

major_16_tower.title: XVI. The Tower
major_16_tower.summary: The Tower corresponds to Mars, representing sudden, destructive, and forceful cosmic energy.
major_16_tower.fullText: The lightning-struck Tower is ruled by Mars, the planet of forceful action and aggression. It channels a destructive but necessary cosmic energy that tears down false structures so truth can be rebuilt.

major_17_star.title: XVII. The Star
major_17_star.summary: The Star is assigned to Aquarius, the reformer focused on long-range vision and humanitarian hope.
major_17_star.fullText: The Star is the progressive reformer of the deck, assigned to Aquarius and ruled by Uranus. She wants to be part of a larger constellation, focusing her healing energies on tomorrow's children and long-range, visionary planning.

major_18_moon.title: XVIII. The Moon
major_18_moon.summary: The Moon card is assigned to Pisces, representing the visionary, dreams, and psychic depths.
major_18_moon.fullText: The Moon card corresponds to Pisces, the visionary fish ruled by Neptune. It plunges into the murky, intuitive depths of the subconscious, navigating through dreams, illusions, and profound psychic sensitivity.

major_19_sun.title: XIX. The Sun
major_19_sun.summary: The Sun card corresponds to the Sun itself, the source of enlightenment, life, and ego.
major_19_sun.fullText: The Sun, the sustainer of life, naturally corresponds with the astrological Sun. It acts as the ultimate source of vital energy, clarity, enlightenment, and the joyous expression of the self.

major_20_judgment.title: XX. Judgment
major_20_judgment.summary: Judgment corresponds to Pluto, signaling a final call for resurrection and deep understanding.
major_20_judgment.fullText: Assigned to Pluto, Judgment represents a last call for awareness, understanding, and acceptance. It is a spiritual awakening tied to the planet of death, resurrection, and unavoidable, total life transformation.

major_21_world.title: XXI. The World
major_21_world.summary: The World corresponds to Saturn, representing physical boundaries, structure, and completion.
major_21_world.fullText: The World represents our earthly home and is assigned to Saturn, the ringed planet of boundaries, limitations, restrictions, and ultimate structure. It signifies the completion of a major karmic or material cycle.

minor_2_wands.title: Two of Wands
minor_2_wands.summary: The Two of Wands corresponds to the first decan of Aries, sub-ruled by Mars.
minor_2_wands.fullText: As a cardinal fire sign, Aries is assigned to the first three numbered cards of the fiery Wands suit. The Two of Wands specifically aligns with the first decan (0°–10°) of Aries, which is sub-ruled by Mars in the Chaldean order. This integrates the aggressive, action-oriented influence of Mars with the passionate, spiritual energy of the Wands.

minor_1_wands.title: Ace of Wands
minor_1_wands.astrological_association: Root of the Element of Fire
minor_1_wands.summary: The Ace of Wands is the undivided root of Fire, before it enters any sign.
minor_1_wands.fullText: Unlike the numbered cards, the Ace is not assigned to a decan. It represents the element of Fire in its pure, unexpressed state — the seed of will, drive, and creative spirit from which the whole suit unfolds. It governs all three fire signs (Aries, Leo, Sagittarius) rather than any single division of the zodiac, and marks a beginning whose form is not yet decided.

minor_1_pentacles.title: Ace of Pentacles
minor_1_pentacles.astrological_association: Root of the Element of Earth
minor_1_pentacles.summary: The Ace of Pentacles is the undivided root of Earth, before it enters any sign.
minor_1_pentacles.fullText: Unlike the numbered cards, the Ace is not assigned to a decan. It represents the element of Earth in its pure, unexpressed state — the seed of body, resource, and material craft from which the whole suit unfolds. It governs all three earth signs (Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn) rather than any single division of the zodiac, and marks a beginning whose form is not yet decided.

minor_11_wands.title: Page of Wands
minor_11_wands.summary: The Page of Wands expresses Fire as page-level mastery of will, drive, and creative spirit.
minor_11_wands.fullText: The court cards personify their element rather than mapping to a single decan. The Page of Wands is the receptive, student expression of the element — beginnings, messages, and untrained potential, applied to will, drive, and creative spirit. It spans the fire triplicity (Aries, Leo, Sagittarius) and in a reading most often indicates either a person carrying this quality or the need for the querent to adopt it.
